scope.historical_logs: bounded unified-log queries over 2026-10-27 23:50 through 2026-10-28 03:25 JST; process/message predicates limited to storage, cache-delete, snapshots, and swap

forecast_stop.interpretation: the 5 GiB volume-free-space guard stopped the run; elapsed time was about 3h18m38s, below the 18h cap

run_artifact_scope.note: saved artifact sizes are far smaller than the multi-GB volume-free-space change; no attribution of unrelated volume consumption to the run

volume_samples.sampled_delta_scope_note: difference between two status samples; not an isolated model-run accounting interval

swap_observation.interpretation: all 11 one-GiB swap files have mtimes before the Oct 28 run; current swap use does not establish that swap grew during the run; no historical per-run swap sample was found

snapshots.snapshot_note: one system update snapshot is marked non-purgeable and as limiting minimum APFS container size; snapshot-pinned bytes and relevance to the historical free-space change are unknown

deleted_open_files_current_sample.interpretation: open-unlinked files can keep storage allocated until the final descriptor closes; lsof SIZE/OFF is logical size, not a measured APFS block allocation; unlink times are unavailable, so this current sample cannot account for the historical multi-GB delta

historical_unified_log.query_process: mobileassetd CacheDelete milestones, plus bounded APFS/disk-management/backup/swap process queries
historical_unified_log.interpretation: Data-volume automatic asset reclamation repeatedly attempted about 1–2 GiB before/during/after the run and reported zero reclaimed with about 3.91 GB metadata-blocked. This supports contemporaneous low-reclaimability pressure, but does not identify the writer(s) or explain the exact free-space delta. The bounded APFS and swap queries returned no event identifying a new swapfile or specific disk consumer.
